name: Example 3 - Generic inbound webhook -> WhatsApp notification

nodes.name: Generic Inbound Webhook
nodes.notes: Point any third-party service's outgoing webhook at this URL: a monitoring tool, a payment processor, Stripe, an uptime checker, a Zapier/Make relay, etc. This pattern also doubles as the practical way to react to Wasaas's own inbound-message endpoint today: have the gateway/worker that calls Wasaas's POST /api/v1/incoming also forward a copy here, since Wasaas itself does not yet dispatch outbound webhooks (see WasaasTrigger node notice and docs/WEBHOOK-STATUS.md).

meta.description: Generic pattern: any system that can fire an outgoing webhook (monitoring, payments, forms, another automation tool) hits this n8n webhook, and a WhatsApp notification goes to a fixed ops number via Wasaas. Verified by static review only (no live n8n instance in this environment).
